card.name: Position just before a large count
card.fires_on: The space or small word right after a quantity phrase such as over, about, more than or virtually, where a big number or sweeping total comes next. It appears in statistics and general prose.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank token after over, about or more than, just before a figure of cases, deaths or people.

modes.label: Sweeping quantity word
modes.description: A word like all or first that sets up a broad total or a superlative.
modes.example: virtually<< all>> books published in the Victorian age

card.writes: It pushes toward broad group nouns such as industries, universities and national, and away from company-ownership words like shareholders.
card.plain: It fires right before a large count or sweeping total, such as over 350 or virtually all.
